question: Which cutting-edge cancer treatment, jointly developed by T-Bombay and Tata Memorial Centre, received DCGI approval for Phase-1 trials in December 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**CAR-T cell therapy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **CAR-T cell therapy** is an innovative cancer treatment that modifies a patient’s T cells to attack cancer cells more effectively.
 
• It involves using **genetically engineered T cells** to recognize and destroy specific cancer cells.
 
• This therapy was jointly developed by **IIT Bombay** and the **Tata Memorial Centre**, two leading organizations in India. *Hence, statement is correct.*
 
• In **December 2024**, the **DCGI (Drug Controller General of India)** approved Phase-1 clinical trials, marking a significant milestone in Indian cancer research.
 
• Phase-1 trials are designed to test the **safety, dosage, and initial efficacy** of the therapy on human subjects. *Hence, statement is correct.*
 
• **CAR-T cell therapy** is particularly effective in treating **blood cancers** such as **leukemia** and **lymphoma**.
 
• The development of this therapy highlights **India’s growing capabilities** in advanced medical research and biotechnology. *Hence, the correct answer is CAR-T cell therapy.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **CAR-T cell therapy:**

 
 
• **Chimeric Antigen Receptor (CAR)-T cells** are created by genetically engineering a patient’s T cells to express receptors specific to cancer cell antigens.
 
• The therapy uses advanced techniques such as **gene editing** and **cellular engineering** to enhance the immune response against cancer.
 
• CAR-T cell therapy has shown remarkable success in treating cancers like **acute lymphoblastic leukemia** (ALL) and **non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma**.
 
 
 
• **Comparison with other therapies:**
 
 
• **Oncolytic viral therapy:** Uses genetically modified viruses to infect and kill cancer cells but lacks the specificity and advanced engineering of CAR-T cells.
 
• **CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing:** While powerful for genetic modifications, it is not exclusively focused on cancer treatment.
 
• **siRNA nanotherapy:** Utilizes RNA interference to silence cancer-related genes but does not involve cellular engineering like CAR-T therapy.
 
 
 
• **Global developments:**
 
 
• **CAR-T therapy** has been approved by global regulatory bodies such as the FDA for use in the United States, with ongoing research in various countries.
 
• India’s entry into CAR-T cell therapy development is a promising step toward self-reliance in cutting-edge medical treatments.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Characteristics of CAR-T cell therapy:**

 
 
• CAR-T therapy involves **personalized medicine**, as the patient’s own cells are engineered for treatment.
 
• This therapy is often used for patients who do not respond to conventional treatments like chemotherapy or radiation.
 
• CAR-T therapy is expensive but has the potential to be life-saving for patients with advanced cancers.
 
 
 
• **Future scope:**
 
 
• Ongoing research aims to make CAR-T therapy more accessible and effective for solid tumors, which are currently challenging to treat.
 
• Collaboration between institutions like IIT Bombay and Tata Memorial Centre is critical for advancing medical innovation in India.
